ruleset.name: SilverAssistWP
ruleset.description:
Shared WordPress Coding Standards ruleset for Silver Assist plugins. Consumers reference this as `<rule ref="SilverAssistWP"/>` from their own thin phpcs.xml (see this package's README for the exact snippet, including the per-plugin PrefixAllGlobals block that cannot live here).
Deliberately does NOT layer silverassist/coding-standards' PSR-12 "SilverAssist" ruleset on top: WordPress-Extra's formatting rules (tabs, brace placement, spacing) are a different, incompatible convention from PSR-12, and WordPress-Extra is the correct authority for a WordPress plugin. The dependency on silverassist/coding-standards exists for the shared PHPStan base (phpstan/base.neon) and to pin both packages' tooling versions (php_codesniffer, phpstan) together — not for PHPCS rule composition.
